pr_body:
- Added default value.
- Links to the explanation of Msaa on wikipedia.
- Added a short example to show how to use the struct on an app.

Fixes #3167.
pr_comments:
Good catch.
Interestingly, I ran `cargo run -p ci` locally, but it didn't error over that. It seems the local ci only runs `bevy_ecs_compile_fail_tests`. Is this intentional?

`cargo run -p ci` is meant to run the tests other that cargo test.

In Bevy CI:
- `cargo test --workspace` run on windows stable, macos stable, linux stable and linux nightly
- `cargo run -p ci` run on linux stable, as most of those (fmt, clippy) are platform independent anyway

issue_context.title: Document the behavior of the `Msaa` resource
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

[Current docs](https://docs.rs/bevy/0.5.0/bevy/prelude/struct.Msaa.html) are not very useful. They should:

- expand the acronym
- link to an external explanation of the anti-aliasing
- note the default values
- note the effect of changing the values
- demonstrate how to configure MSAA in your app with a simple example
